options.feedback: Incorrect. The first part refers to unspecified time (Present Perfect), the second to a specific past time (Past Simple).
Correct. 'Have been' covers the experience up to now, and 'went' specifies a finished time (last year).

Incorrect. The second part requires Past Simple, not Past Continuous.

questions.explanation:
Present Perfect is used for experiences at an unspecified time in the past. Past Simple is used for actions completed at a specific time (e.g., last year).
